mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over three consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the probability of future monetary policy easing and reduces inflation expectations, thereby boosting equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which implies robust corporate revenue growth and elevated profit expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 over two consecutive months indicates weakening real economic activity, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention and reduces the risk of overheating, leading to positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate, signals persistent inflationary pressures that trigger a hawkish monetary policy response, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 450,000 million dollars, combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1), indicates strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative or non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 143,000 thousand, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals labor market contraction, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus, boosting equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a supply-side shock or demand collapse, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention and reduces real interest rates, leading to positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).
